:::{#thm-bernoulli-score-sum}
#### Score function of a binary sample

If $\Outvar_\iobs \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $\iobs = 1, \dots, n$,
with observed [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) $\outbar$,
[precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision) $\precision = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$,
and sample mean $\smeandev \eqdef \avgin \devn_\iobs$ of the [deviations](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) $\devn_\iobs = \outvar_\iobs - \prob$,
the [score function](#def-score) is:

$$\score(\prob) = n \precision \smeandev = n \precision (\outbar - \prob)$$

:::

::: proof

The first equality is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-score-sum, worked in @sol-bernoulli-score-sum.
The second is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-sample-mean-deviation, worked in @sol-bernoulli-sample-mean-deviation.

:::
